name: 100x-persona
author: 100x
summary: Script draft text in -> delivering persona + independent physical scene out, each traceable back to a literal quote in the script, for casting/shooting decisions.

validation.structural_and_per_item: schema.json (JSON Schema draft-07), actually EXECUTED by ajv (devDependency declared in package.json, run 'npm install' first) inside scripts/validate.js -- enforces required fields, type, additionalProperties:false, enum (relationship_to_camera), pattern (scene vague-word ban, ID key formats), minLength/minItems, propertyNames, const. This is everything vanilla JSON Schema CAN express, and it is genuinely checked by a real validator (ajv), not hand-written field enumeration.
validation.cross_item_aggregate: scripts/validate.js's hand-written layer -- the real, runnable enforcement of: axiom 1 (persona_ref/scene_ref referential integrity -- the ref string must match an actual key in personas/scenes, not just the right format, which is all ajv's pattern keyword can check), axiom 2 (authority_evidence_quote / audience_pain_quote / script_span_quote must be literal substrings of source_script -- a cross-field comparison JSON Schema cannot express at all), and axiom 4 (zero-orphan coverage -- every defined persona/scene key must be referenced by >=1 pairing). Run 'node scripts/validate.js --selftest' for the built-in regression suite (10 checks: 3 real evals pass, unknown persona_ref fails, unknown scene_ref fails, paraphrased evidence quote fails, orphan scene fails, injected additionalProperty fails via ajv, invalid enum fails via ajv, hedge-marker quote with no disclosure fails, same quote with disclosure passes, refutation-framed reversal with no listed hedge marker passes cleanly -- a documented known gap, not a bug).
validation.authority_hedge_mitigation: Axiom 2's literal-substring check proves a quote was copied verbatim, never that its meaning in the persona field matches its meaning in source_script -- a self-doubting/hedged sentence (e.g. 'if you don't believe me' / 如果你不信我) is a valid substring and can be used backwards as a false authority anchor. This is a semantic-understanding problem, not fixable by more string/regex/schema layers. scripts/validate.js's checkAuthorityHedgeRisk adds: a closed list of hedge/self-doubt phrases scanned ONLY in authority_evidence_quote; a hit requires a matching meta.warnings disclosure (persona id + 'hedge'/'自我怀疑') or the bundle FAILs. This converts the counterexample from a silent pass into a mandatory-disclosure failure -- it does NOT detect reversal via refutation/sarcasm framing, translation, or any phrasing outside the closed list. --selftest check 10/10 is a real regression test that intentionally documents this remaining gap (0 errors on a refutation-framed reversal), not a claim that it's fixed. See axioms.md #2 for the full writeup.
validation.note: Same class of schema/script split as 100x-search-query's metadata.json documents, now with the structural half actually delegated to a real validator rather than reimplemented by hand.

input_contract.note: This repo does not yet have a shared cross-skill input schema (schemas/ is empty). Input is described informally here and in workflow.md Phase 1. No class-B soft-degrade fields -- source_script is the only input this skill needs; there is no optional secondary field with a 3-level degrade like 100x-search-query's core_benefit.

requires_data_note: Not runtime dependencies -- this skill is purely generative and does not query a corpus at inference time. 'taxonomy.script_blueprint_authority_pain_modules' records that persona field design (authority_basis/audience_fit) was informed by modules 2 (Authority) and 3 (Pain) of the script blueprint. 'taxonomy.scene_library_field_schema' and 'taxonomy.persona_library_field_schema' record that the scene_item/persona_item field shapes were informed by taxonomy templates -- field names only. No corpus/table content is stored in this repo.

ported_from.adaptation_summary: Synthesizes judgment-design style, structured field shapes, and persona-signal categories for physical video-scene and persona modeling. See sources.md for design decisions.

language_scope.output_language: structured fields are bilingual by design: identity_label/authority_basis/audience_fit/delivery_style/scene descriptive fields are Chinese (for downstream Chinese-speaking production teams), while *_evidence_quote/*_pain_quote/script_span_quote are always literal excerpts in the source_script's original language (checked as exact substrings, never translated or paraphrased -- axiom 2).
language_scope.input_language: source_script may be in any language the production team writes scripts in; evidence-quote substring checks are language-agnostic (plain string containment).

eval_policy: evals/ contains synthetic/fictional products and personas only. No real transcript text, account name, product name, or Feishu link may appear in this skill's files.
